info.title: API.SH: ADS-B Exchange
info.description: The ADS-B Exchange API from API.SH: public ADS-B Exchange data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.summary: ADS-B Exchange live aircraft by hex, registration or callsign
get.description:
The live state of one aircraft: position, barometric and GPS altitude, ground and air speeds, track and headings, vertical rates, squawk, emergency status, category, selected altitude and heading, QNH, winds and temperatures when broadcast, data source (ADS-B, MLAT, TIS-B...), military flag, signal quality and how long ago it was seen. Answers 404 when the aircraft is not being tracked now.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/adsbexchange-aircraft

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: ADS-B Exchange live aircraft in an area
get.description:
Every aircraft tracked now in a circle (sorted by distance, with `distance_nm`) or a lat/lon box, with altitude, type, squawk, callsign and military filters. Each aircraft carries the full live state. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/adsbexchange-area

parameters.name: radius_nm
parameters.description: Circle radius in nautical miles (1-250, default 25).

parameters.name: box
parameters.description: A box instead of a circle: `south,north,west,east` in degrees.

parameters.name: min_altitude_ft
parameters.description: Only aircraft at or above this barometric altitude (feet).

parameters.name: max_altitude_ft
parameters.description: Only aircraft at or below this altitude (feet).

parameters.name: squawk
parameters.description: Only aircraft squawking this code (4 octal digits).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: ADS-B Exchange closest aircraft to a point
get.description:
The aircraft closest to a point within a radius, with its distance and full live state; the same filters as /adsbexchange/v1/area.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/adsbexchange-closest

parameters.name: radius_nm
parameters.description: Search radius in nautical miles (1-500, default 100).

parameters.name: min_altitude_ft
parameters.description: Only aircraft at or above this barometric altitude (feet).

parameters.name: max_altitude_ft
parameters.description: Only aircraft at or below this altitude (feet).

parameters.name: squawk
parameters.description: Only aircraft squawking this code (4 octal digits).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every military aircraft tracked now worldwide, with the full live state; optional altitude, squawk, callsign and type filters. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/adsbexchange-military

parameters.name: min_altitude_ft
parameters.description: Only aircraft at or above this barometric altitude (feet).

parameters.name: max_altitude_ft
parameters.description: Only aircraft at or below this altitude (feet).

parameters.name: squawk
parameters.description: Only aircraft squawking this code (4 octal digits).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: ADS-B Exchange aircraft squawking a code
get.description:
Every aircraft worldwide squawking one transponder code now: 7700 (emergency, default), 7600 (radio failure), 7500 (hijack) or any other code. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/adsbexchange-squawk

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
An aircraft's position history for the current UTC day: time, position, altitude, ground speed, track, vertical rates, airspeed, roll, source, new-leg marks, and callsign and squawk where they changed; `recent=true` returns only the last minutes. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/adsbexchange-trace

parameters.name: recent
parameters.description: true: only the most recent part of the track.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: ADS-B Exchange live aircraft of one type
get.description:
Every aircraft of one ICAO type tracked now worldwide, with the full live state. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/adsbexchange-type

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
